title: Keep the streak
prompt: Stage 3-2, 47 gold, 79 HP, four losses in a row. Your board is weak and not close to anything. A 2-cost pair sits on your bench. Do you break the streak?

options.label: Keep losing: bank interest and streak gold, level and roll at 4-1 in one big rolldown.
Level to 6 and put the pair in to try to win the next two fights.
Roll 20 now to stabilise before HP gets low.

explanation:
Four losses at 3-2 with 79 HP is a loss streak you are already paying for, so collect what it pays: the streak bonus on top of interest every round, plus the strongest carousel picks. Trying to win now with a level and one 2-star costs you the streak gold and probably still loses, which is the worst of both. Rolling 20 at level 5 finds 1- and 2-cost pairs that do not make a board and drops you under 50.

The plan is to arrive at 4-1 with 90-plus gold and 60-plus HP, level to 7 or 8, and roll down once into a real board. The HP is the price; you have it.
principle: A loss streak is a decision, not an accident. Once you are in it, stay in it until the rolldown.
commonMistake: Breaking a streak for a single unlikely win, losing anyway, and arriving at 4-1 with neither gold nor HP.
